 New retail dollar bond offer set to launch this week
 Arthur Fuentes ,
 ABS-CBN News
 Published November 16, 2026 03:27 PM PHT 
 MANILA — The Philippines will launch its third tranche of retail dollar bonds on Thursday, offering eligible investors US dollar-denominated government securities with a minimum investment of $200, state-run Land Bank of the Philippines announced.
 The three-year Retail Dollar Bonds 3 (RDB 3) will be offered from November 19 to November 24, with the official issue date scheduled for November 27, the bank said in a public advisory.
 The Bureau of the Treasury (BTr) will determine the applicable interest rate on November 19, the opening day of the offer period. Interest payments will be distributed quarterly, though the BTr noted it may close or adjust the offer period earlier.
 Billed as an opportunity for individuals to invest in their future while supporting nation-building, the securities will be accessible online. Starting November 19, eligible investors can place their investments directly through the LANDBANK Mobile Banking App (MBA).
 ADVERTISEMENT
 Ahead of the official launch, prospective buyers were advised to download or update the application via Google Play, the Apple App Store, or the Huawei AppGallery.
 Further details regarding the RDB 3 offering can be accessed through the Bureau of the Treasury's official website.
 The dollar has appreciated significantly against the peso this year, following the US-Israeli attack on Iran in February. From P57.665 per dollar at the end of February, the dollar strengthened to as high as P64.17 in October.
